run.platform: Linux x86_64, 32 logical CPUs, at least 64 GiB of memory
run.v4.41.1: commit 4af19e1c447b8b9f8a621a984e8cc0558195bf3b, pg35 harness files copied from v4.42.0

pg35.description: 35 SQL categories; Nano embedded and in memory, PostgreSQL over loopback TCP; 300 timed iterations per category after 2 warm-ups, every result checked; median over rounds; times per statement in microseconds

postgres.version: PostgreSQL 18.4 (Debian 18.4-1.pgdg12+1) on x86_64-pc-linux-gnu, compiled by gcc (Debian 12.2.0-14+deb12u1) 12.2.0, 64-bit

wire.description: one-row UPDATE by primary key over the PostgreSQL wire against a running server; 'extended' is a prepared statement bound per execution, 'simple' the statement as text; each client has its own connection and its own rows; client and server on one host

pgbench.description: pgbench and psql from the postgres:18.4-bookworm image against PostgreSQL and each Nano server; 8 s per cell; runs listed in the order made (the Nano servers alternate)
